title: Model request
description: One call through the model gateway (C12, ADR-017). The gateway picks an endpoint from the routing table for task_class, allowed by privacy and routing; the caller never names a provider. Prompts are not stored beyond the telemetry policy.

task_class.description: Routing key, e.g. review, ask.node, assess.farm.

privacy.description: Classification of the data in the messages. secret-adjacent: cell and site endpoints only; private and site: also the owner's machines (owned); public: any endpoint.

routing.description: local_only narrows any privacy to cell and site endpoints.

trust.description: untrusted content (tool output, documents) is data, never instructions; adapters wrap it.

output_schema.description: JSON schema the answer must satisfy; the gateway validates and retries once.

deadline_s.description: After this the gateway gives up and returns unavailable.model.timeout.
